candidates.change_summary: Remove the require(callResult) statement so that a failed external call does not revert the entire transaction, leaving credit zeroed and balance reduced.
Remove the credit[msg.sender]=0 assignment after the external call, so the user can call withdrawAll again to observe difference in credit mapping.
Remove the balance-=oCredit deduction so that balance does not reflect withdrawn amount, changing subsequent deposits/withdrawals impact on contract ether.
Move credit[msg.sender]=0 before the external call so that reentrant calls see zero credit, altering behavior under reentrancy.
Replace the condition oCredit>0 with true so that function always attempts a zero-credit withdrawal, which would revert differently.
Remove the __lock_modifier0_lock = false reset after execution, causing the modifier to permanently lock after first use, making all subsequent calls revert.
Remove the require(!__lock_modifier0_lock) guard, allowing reentrant calls that would change behavior (e.g., double withdrawal).
